Stable centered hips, steady heads, capes/tails trailing opposite the stride. Not an idle sheet. Rows 1 small gray-brown rat in rust-red tunic carrying dagger; 2 rust-hooded rat scout with short crossbow; 3 green-robed rat mage with upright violet-crystal staff; 4 stout crowned Rat King with red cape and poleaxe. All 32 sprites face southeast/right toward viewer, face and chest visible. Each character same anatomy/scale in all eight columns, feet land at same baseline. Pose 8 loops into pose 1. No labels or numbers or floor.

Production low-resolution pixel-art ANIMATION atlas for the supplied original Burrow & Fang characters. Reference is character identity and art style ONLY; create new animation poses. Crisp chunky 16-bit pixel clusters, flat limited shades, no fuzzy shading, no added ornament. TRUE transparent PNG. Exact EIGHT columns and FOUR rows in a rigid equal-cell grid; ONE whole character in every cell, generous empty gutters. Each ROW must keep IDENTICAL clothing, head, body proportions and size across every frame, pelvis centered at same cell X, feet contact the same baseline. Never recenter based on weapons or tails. No ground or cast shadows. Rows: 1 small gray-brown rat in rust tunic with dagger; 2 hooded rat scout with compact crossbow; 3 green-robed rat mage with violet crystal staff; 4 stout crowned Rat King in red cape with poleaxe. All characters face RIGHT/southeast. EIGHT columns in order: 1 relaxed ready stance; 2 subtle idle inhale and tail twitch (same feet); 3 attack anticipation leaning slightly back weapon drawn; 4 deep wind-up with planted front foot; 5 clear extended STRIKE or projectile release; 6 follow-through with weapon across body; 7 recoil/recovery toward ready; 8 settle back into ready. Daggers stab, crossbow/bow aims and shoots, staffs thrust to cast, poleaxe/axe swings. Same head and torso scale every frame. Anticipation visibly distinct from release. Do not produce eight standing poses.
